qualifier: naive and memory B cell surface markers
name: Naive and memory B cell surface marker signatures
rationale: All members are B/lymphocyte expression modules and surface signatures centred on naive and memory B cells, lacking the germinal-centre, Tfh, plasma-cell and B cell activation/differentiation members of the confusables.

qualifier: melanin synthesis and pigment granule localization
name: MITF-M target programs and melanin pigmentation
rationale: Members are MITF-M target gene programs plus melanin biosynthesis, pigment granule localization and pigmentation defects, distinguishing them from confusables centred on UV/blue-light response, melanocyte proliferation and MITF-driven apoptosis.

name: Epithelial anchoring junctions, apicobasal polarity and EMT
rationale: Members cover cadherin adherens junctions, desmosomes, hemidesmosomes, apical-basal polarity and EMT, whereas confusables concern negative regulation of cadherin adhesion, endothelial morphogenesis or tight junctions.

name: Pyrimidine (deoxy)nucleotide catabolism and salvage
rationale: Nearly all members are pyrimidine nucleotide/nucleoside/nucleobase catabolism or salvage, distinguishing the theme from purine deoxynucleotide, de novo pyrimidine synthesis and NTP hydrolysis confusables.

name: SLC4 bicarbonate and alkanesulfonate transport
rationale: Members are bicarbonate transporters (SLC4A1/SLC4A4 defects) and alkanesulfonate transport/metabolism, unlike confusables built on SLC26 anion exchange, carbonic anhydrase or enamel mineralization.

core: Hematopoietic stem and progenitor cell regulation
qualifier: stem cell homeostasis, proliferation and differentiation
name: Hematopoietic stem cell homeostasis and progenitor differentiation
rationale: All members regulate HSC maintenance, proliferation or progenitor differentiation, whereas confusables are erythroid differentiation or thymic T cell/bone marrow proliferation.

name: BAF-family ATP-dependent chromatin remodeling complex assembly
rationale: Members are formation of the BAF complex variants plus CHD1/2 remodelers and stem-cell maintenance, unlike confusables centred on nucleosome assembly and histone/protein acetylation.

qualifier: cellular uptake and intracellular cofactor processing, not dietary absorption
name: Cellular cobalamin processing and methylmalonic acidemia defects
rationale: Members cover TCN2/CD320 delivery, intracellular cobalamin processing and MUT/MTR cofactor defects causing MMA/homocystinuria, whereas confusables emphasise intestinal uptake (CUBN, AMN, CBLIF) or other B vitamins.

qualifier: heterochromatin foci, Polycomb silencing and SASP
name: Cellular senescence with heterochromatin foci and secretory phenotype
rationale: Members span oncogene-, stress- and replicative senescence with SAHF, PML bodies, Polycomb modules and SASP, distinguishing them from confusables on p53 apoptosis, p16/ARF senescence evasion or UV response.

name: Toll-like receptor TRAF6/TRIF-driven TAK1 complex activation
rationale: Members describe TLR-induced TAK1 (and RIP1-IKK) activation via TRAF6, IRAK2 and TRIF, unlike confusables on JNK cascades, IRAK1-IKK/NF-kB regulation or TLR3/4-induced cell death and cytokines.

name: Lipid droplet biogenesis and triglyceride storage homeostasis
rationale: Members cover lipid droplet formation, fusion and organization with triglyceride and fatty acid homeostasis, whereas confusables emphasise lipolysis/lipophagy, LXR lipogenesis or phospholipid synthesis.

name: Cornified envelope assembly and skin barrier formation
rationale: All members concern cornification, peptide cross-linking and the epidermal barrier, distinguishing them from hepoxilin synthesis, cell junction and keratinocyte proliferation/differentiation confusables.

qualifier: constitutive EGFR and ERBB2 cancer mutants
name: Constitutive signaling by cancer-mutant EGFR and ERBB2
rationale: All members are constitutive signaling by mutant EGFR or ERBB2, unlike confusables on ERBB2 drug resistance or FGFR amplification/fusion signaling.

name: Cytidine deamination in antibody diversification and antiviral restriction
rationale: Members combine AID/APOBEC C-to-U deamination, somatic hypermutation, class switching, V(D)J recombination and APOBEC3G antiviral restriction, unlike confusables on HIV replication steps or ADAR A-to-I editing.

name: Histamine, leukotriene and prostanoid G protein-coupled receptors
rationale: Members are GPCR modules and leukotriene, prostanoid and histamine receptor signaling, with histamine receptors/metabolism distinguishing it from eicosanoid synthesis and endocannabinoid confusables.

qualifier: lysis, agglutination and metal sequestration effectors
name: Innate antibacterial effectors: lysis, agglutination, metal sequestration
rationale: Members are mucosal and neutrophil antibacterial defense via cytolysis, peptidoglycan targeting, agglutination and metal sequestration, whereas confusables centre on defensins or antifungal responses.

name: Folate, cobalamin and methionine one-carbon metabolism
rationale: Members cover folate metabolism, cobalamin uptake/processing defects and methionine/SAM metabolism, unlike confusables on carnitine/choline, histidine or other B vitamins.

qualifier: CYP-mediated vitamin D activation and retinoic acid turnover
name: CYP-mediated vitamin D and retinoic acid metabolism
rationale: Members are vitamin D and retinoic acid synthesis, catabolism and response including CYP27B1/CYP24A1/CYP26 defects, distinguishing them from steroid hormone, vitamin K and retinol/retinal confusables.

qualifier: SRP and tail-anchored membrane insertion, retention and quality control
name: ER protein targeting, membrane insertion and quality control
rationale: Members cover SRP-dependent and tail-anchored targeting/insertion into the ER, ER retention, quality control and exit, unlike confusables centred on COPII export or ERAD.

name: Androgen receptor signaling with RUNX2-driven bone development
rationale: Members are androgen/AR responses and prostate epithelial regulation together with RUNX2 osteoblast and bone development terms, which distinguish it from estrogen, progesterone and thyroid receptor confusables.

name: Dopamine receptor signaling via adenylate cyclase and beta-arrestin
rationale: Members are dopamine receptor signaling through adenylate cyclase or beta-arrestin and locomotor regulation, unlike confusables on PLC-coupled signaling, dopamine synthesis/transport or drug-related behaviour.

qualifier: erythroid heme expression signatures and heme A
name: Heme biosynthesis expression signatures and heme A synthesis
rationale: Members are heme biosynthesis/metabolism expression modules and heme A synthesis, distinguishing them from heme B/porphyrin pathway, iron-sulfur cluster and HMOX1/iron confusables.

name: Mitochondrial tRNA processing and RNA pseudouridylation
rationale: Members are mitochondrial tRNA processing/modification and pseudouridine synthesis in tRNA, rRNA and mRNA, unlike confusables on mitoribosome assembly, RNA import or tRNA aminoacylation/methylation.

name: Receptor-mediated viral attachment, entry and cell-cell fusion
rationale: All members describe receptor-mediated virion attachment, endocytic entry and fusion, whereas confusables cover virus-specific maturation, assembly or regulation of entry.

name: Small RNA biogenesis and miRNA-mediated post-transcriptional silencing
rationale: Members cover miRNA/siRNA processing, RISC assembly and miRNA-directed translational repression and mRNA decay, unlike confusables on ARE-binding protein decay, decapping, or ceRNA/lncRNA regulation.
